messages:
Emma (Product): Quick async — v2 routing launch readiness check. TL;DR: targeting canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Please reply with: what you did / blockers / today and flag any hard no's. I'll collate.
Sam_H (Eng): Did: merged routing fallback + basic metrics. Blocker: flaky integration tests on GPU nodes. Today: debugging test infra and reproducing perf spike. Ping @Marco for capacity.
Marco (Eng Manager): Did: capacity plan approved with infra; reserved extra slots for canary. Blocker: storage quota for KV cache needs bump (holding canary until resolved). Today: coordinating with eng-infra and SRE.
Priya (Design): Did: updated confirmation modal and added error state variants after legal feedback. Blocker: need final product sign-off on wording for error state B. Today: will add annotations in Figma.
Alex_G (QA): Did: smoke tests for main flows pass locally. Blocker: can't run full e2e against staged models — missing staging creds. Today: waiting on creds, will run regression once provided.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-v2-routing at 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC. Details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1234 :rotating_light:
Sam_H (Eng): Quick ask: propose 1h manual canary with rollback window; proceed even if the integration tests are flaky but we gate on SLOs and smoke tests. :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:?
Emma (Product): I approve 1h manual canary provided infra can monitor SLOs and QA runs regression during that window. I'll send a calendar invite and post the canary checklist.
Chris_Admin (Eng-Infra): KV cache quota increased (done). I'll enable the SLO dashboard and set alerts by EOD.
Marco (Eng Manager): Thanks Chris. PRs to review before canary: #4820 (routing fallback), #4831 (metrics). @Emma please prioritize review for #4820.
Emma (Product): I'll review #4820 tonight. Also drafting rollback playbook in Confluence — will drop link here when ready.
Priya (Design): Quick question: on error state 3, should we surface a retry CTA or direct to support? @Emma
Emma (Product): Retry CTA for first two failures, then show support link after 2 attempts. Legal okayed the copy.
Alex_G (QA): Received creds, starting full regression now. ETA ~2.5h.
Sam_H (Eng): FYI: observed a latency spike at seq_len 4096 in perf env during a stress run. Instrumenting more; if persistent we should limit canary to seq_len 2048.
Marco (Eng Manager): Noted. Current blockers summary: integ test flakes (investigating), perf spike at long seq (Sam investigating), quota (resolved), regression creds (resolved). Looks like green for canary unless the perf spike persists.
Emma (Product): Good summary. If perf spike holds, we'll run canary with limited seq_len and expand later. Please update this thread as you make progress. I'll consolidate and post final go/no-go ~2h before window.
Sam_H (Eng): :thumbsup:
Emma (Product): Thanks everyone — ping me if anything changes. I'll follow up with the canary checklist and the Confluence link for the rollback playbook when done.
